Holiday Ideas

Family holiday in the Tyrolean Oberland

Kids, pack your hiking boots! This request may be met with grumbling at first, but after the first of the many themed trails at the latest, even the youngsters will be looking forward to their hiking adventure.

We recommend it because:

  • the region with the upper Inntal, Kaunertal and Nauders in the border triangle offers an exceptionally varied landscape with glaciers, gorges, moors and high alpine pastures.
  • over 30 varied themed trails - from tunnels and fairytale forests to playful water trails - offer special hiking experiences for young and old.
  • in addition to castles and ruins, there are also numerous adventures such as canyoning, rafting, high ropes courses and special offers for young people and children.

Mountain railways in this region

These four cable cars also transport families up the mountain in summer. Little bikers will find their sporting adventure in the Goldbike Park at the Bergkastel mountain station. There are family-friendly hiking trails on the Mutzkopf and from the mountain station in Fendels. The Karlesjochbahn cable car takes families up to over 3,000 metres above sea level, where they can immerse themselves in the world of glacier ice.

Family adventures in Nauders - Tyrolean Oberland - Kaunertal

  • Goldpark Nauderix

    The adventure world combines play, water and exciting stories about gold panning.

    Learn more

  • Verpeil Gorge Kaunertal

    The trail leads past waterfalls, through gorges and over a suspension bridge.

    Learn more

  • Summer mountain Fendels

    There is a tree house, a climbing park, a trampoline, water games and much more.

    Learn more

  • Radurschlklamm Gorge

    Ideal for hot summer days. The gorge is home to a variety of alpine flora.

    Learn more

  • Kaunergrat Nature Park House

    Multimedia exhibition "3,000m vertical", which offers entertaining insights into the region's habitats.

  • Ried bathing lake

    40 metre long giant slide, Action Tower XXL, Balance Beam and much more.

    Learn more

Travelling sustainably

  • The nearest railway station to Nauders is Landeck-Zams. From there, you can take a comfortable and environmentally friendly bus to Nauders.
  • Local hiking and leisure destinations can be easily reached by public buses or hiking buses.
  • Guests receive the Summercard Basic free of charge with every overnight stay, which allows you to use the regional buses, among other things.
